verdict.rationale: Close documents three tiered MCP scopes (read-only, write-safe, write-destructive). These let an agent connecting through the official MCP server be held to least privilege. However, the evidence for plain API keys and OAuth shows only that they exist, with no per-key or per-resource scoping. missing for 10: scoping for REST API keys, granular per-object or per-endpoint permissions beyond three coarse tiers, documentation on issuing agent-specific credentials, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: mcp.read — read-only access; mcp.write_safe — can read and write data; mcp.write_destructive — can read, write, and delete data
Give Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other tools direct access to Close data via the MCP server — no code required.
